::: {#def-rss}
#### Residual sum of squares

For a regression model whose conditional mean $\mean(x; \vparam)$
depends on a parameter vector $\vparam$,
the **residual sum of squares** at $\vparam$
is the sum of the squared residuals
$\resid_i(\vparam) \eqdef y_i - \mean(x_i; \vparam)$
that the model has when its parameters equal $\vparam$:

$$\text{RSS}(\vparam) \eqdef \sumin \resid_i(\vparam)^2.$$

At the estimate $\est{\vparam}$,
$\resid_i(\est{\vparam})$ is the [residual](estimation.qmd#def-residual) $\resid_i$
of the fitted model.
:::
